title: backfill.rs silently drops parent CIDs with non-32-byte digest
description: backfill.rs:113-120: if let Ok(raw) = <[u8; 32]>::try_from(digest_bytes) silently skips parent CIDs whose multihash digest is not 32 bytes. The entry is inserted with incomplete ancestry, disconnecting the DAG. append.rs correctly propagates errors; backfill.rs must match. Trigger: adversarially-crafted entry with wrong-length CID digest.
